rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: Trick 1: Signal-word map: since/for → perfect; yesterday/ago → past; tomorrow/next → future; now/at the moment → continuous — map signals to tenses instantly.  ·  Trick 2: The classic traps: stative verbs (know, love) resist continuous; future time clauses take present ('when he comes'); 'since' pairs with perfect.
